::: {#rem-evaluation}
#### How Racket evaluates an application

To **evaluate** an application `(f e1 ... en)` (@def-racket-expression),
Racket evaluates each operand `e1`, ..., `en` to a value,
then applies `f` to those values.
In part 1 of @exr-evaluate-nested:

```text
(* (+ 1 2) (- 10 4))
= (* 3 6)
= 18
```

Each `=` replaces one application by its value,
and the evaluation ends with a value, which cannot be simplified further.

:::
